notes: Create/Edit field rules: provider int; plan_name max 250; plan_code max 100; type in {1,2}; plan_type in {1,2,3}; billing_type in {1,2}; description max 255.
Login and Provider plan list use dxhub-dev-api host from collection; Plan CRUD uses dev-console-api.jpmob.jp from collection.
Detailed View URL was missing in the Postman item; GET /api/v1/plan/provider/{id} assumed—confirm with backend if different.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify that the Delete Plan API removes the plan when a valid plan_id and token are provided.
testCases.testSteps:
1. Open API testing tool or automation environment.
2. Enter API endpoint: https://dev-console-api.jpmob.jp/api/v1/plan/provider/{plan_id}.
3. Select HTTP method: DELETE.
4. Set request headers: Authorization: DXHUB <valid_token>; Content-Type: application/json; Accept: application/json.
5. Provide authentication token as per test (DXHUB <access_token> in Authorization header when required).
6. Enter request payload: no body
7. Send the API request.
8. Verify HTTP status code and response body against Expected Result.
testCases.preCondition: Valid API access token exists. A deletable plan_id exists in the test environment.
testCases.expectedResult: The API should return HTTP 204 No Content or 200 with a success payload per API contract. Subsequent GET detail for the same id should return 404.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify that an error is returned when deleting a non-existent plan_id.
testCases.testSteps:
1. Open API testing tool or automation environment.
2. Enter API endpoint: https://dev-console-api.jpmob.jp/api/v1/plan/provider/999999999.
3. Select HTTP method: DELETE.
4. Set request headers: Authorization: DXHUB <valid_token>; Content-Type: application/json; Accept: application/json.
5. Provide authentication token as per test (DXHUB <access_token> in Authorization header when required).
6. Enter request payload: no body
7. Send the API request.
8. Verify HTTP status code and response body against Expected Result.
testCases.expectedResult: The API should return HTTP 404 with an error indicating the plan was not found.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify that an error is returned when the Delete Plan API is called without Authorization header.
testCases.testSteps:

2. Enter API endpoint: https://dev-console-api.jpmob.jp/api/v1/plan/provider/{plan_id}.
3. Select HTTP method: DELETE.
4. Set request headers: no Authorization.
5. Omit or manipulate Authorization header as per test case.
6. Enter request payload: no body
7. Send the API request.
8. Verify HTTP status code and response body against Expected Result.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify that an error is returned when the Delete Plan API is invoked with GET instead of DELETE.
testCases.testSteps:
1. Open API testing tool or automation environment.
2. Enter API endpoint: https://dev-console-api.jpmob.jp/api/v1/plan/provider/<plan_id>.
3. Select HTTP method: GET.
4. Set request headers: Authorization: DXHUB <valid_token>; Content-Type: application/json; Accept: application/json.
5. Provide authentication token as per test (DXHUB <access_token> in Authorization header when required).
6. Enter request payload: no body
7. Send the API request.
8. Verify HTTP status code and response body against Expected Result.
testCases.expectedResult: The API should return HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed or 200 for detail view if GET is defined for same path; must not delete the resource.
